title: WebPack
description: background-image: linear-gradient(to right, #a855f7, #06b6d4);  Creates a gradient from purple-500 (#a855f7) to cyan-500 (#06b6d4).  -webkit-background-clip: text; & background-clip: text;  Makes sure the gradient applies only to the text

title: Finacial-Club
description: Developed a full-stack event platform for event registration and ticket purchasing. Integrated secure payments via Checkout.com API. Built a credit-based networking system for attendee connections. Implemented Plus and Premier subscription plans with enhanced features. Enabled admin and user-hosted events with customizable ticket pricing. Added coupon and discount systems for promotions
